enemies.name: The Pallbearer
enemies.flavor: A hearse that refuses to pass you.
enemies.behavior: Follows your old footprints and lunges when you stop. Keep moving forward; dash sideways at the toll.

enemies.name: Snapshrike
enemies.flavor: A thrown knife that learned hunger.
enemies.behavior: Orbits, then dashes in a straight line at you. Sidestep when its aim line freezes; pillars stop the dash.

enemies.name: Moteling
enemies.flavor: A million motes that hush the world to hear you stop.
enemies.behavior: Marks the fastest player and shrieks if they move. Stand still until its ring snaps shut.

enemies.name: The Rift Warden
enemies.flavor: A doorway from a dead world, still holding its post.
enemies.behavior: Drifts through walls and shoves everything away from it. Fight it on wide ground, never on a bridge.

enemies.name: Gale Wight
enemies.flavor: The wind between platforms, loaded with a grudge.
enemies.behavior: Drops marked shells from above that explode on the floor. Move off the circle or hide under a bridge.

enemies.name: Lantern Leech
enemies.flavor: Its light is a promise it never intends to keep.
enemies.behavior: Flies to the gift you just picked up and stings anyone near it. Step away and let it gorge on nothing.

enemies.name: Bolt Sentry
enemies.flavor: It has been aiming at this spot since before you arrived.
enemies.behavior: Never moves; charges a bolt along a line it predicts. Break line of sight, then peek while it vents.

enemies.name: False Gift
enemies.flavor: It has been a gift for a long time, and it is patient.
enemies.behavior: Sits still as a gift, then lunges when you come close. Dash through it to reveal it from safety.

enemies.name: Crumble Wisp
enemies.flavor: Where it drifts, the floor forgets how to be a floor.
enemies.behavior: Rots the floor under you: slowed, no abilities. Cross fast and loot somewhere else.

upgrades.name: Zephyr Tread
upgrades.flavor: Soles that remember running before the fall.

upgrades.name: Skyhook Arc
upgrades.flavor: The apex of every jump, held a heartbeat longer.

upgrades.name: Gossamer Descent
upgrades.flavor: Gravity loosens its grip, one breath at a time.

upgrades.name: Dashspur Lash
upgrades.flavor: A whipcrack behind the heels, quickening the burst.

upgrades.name: Ember Rewind
upgrades.flavor: The cooldown burns away like a struck match.

upgrades.name: Twin Feather
upgrades.flavor: Two bright downs left behind by something kinder.

upgrades.name: Lantern Magnet
upgrades.flavor: Gifts lean toward your reaching hand on their own.

upgrades.name: Spare Wick
upgrades.flavor: A second flame, kept for the fall you never see.

upgrades.name: Thinning Shroud
upgrades.flavor: The mist politely forgets to hide the way.

upgrades.name: Beaconflare
upgrades.flavor: The exit beacon burns brighter for your coming.

curses.name: Leadened Soles
curses.flavor: Every step lands like it owes the ground interest.

curses.name: Heavy Air
curses.flavor: Invisible hands press the sky onto your shoulders.

curses.name: Waning Reflex
curses.flavor: The spark between thought and dash gutters.

curses.name: Numb Fingers
curses.flavor: Your hands forget the shape of holding.

curses.name: Closing Mist
curses.flavor: The world shrinks to an arm's length of grey.

curses.name: Hungering Pace
curses.flavor: Somewhere behind you, footsteps quicken in time with yours.

curses.name: Far Senses
curses.flavor: The void's eyes open wider, and further.

curses.name: Rude Awakening
curses.flavor: The things that sleep, wake before you'd like.

curses.name: Swarm Seed
curses.flavor: One more of them. There is always one more of them.

curses.name: The Hollow Choir
curses.flavor: Every voice in the dark sings your route aloud.

curses.name: Leaden Sky
curses.flavor: The firmament itself has taken against you.

curses.name: World of Teeth
curses.flavor: The whole void grinds a little closer, always.

classes.name: Striker
classes.flavor: You were made to close the gap, not to hold it.
classes.ability: Dash a short burst forward, then wait out the cooldown.

classes.name: Grappler
classes.flavor: The void is a wall you have learned to pull against.
classes.ability: Fire an auto-aimed grapple that pulls you to the platform ahead.
classes.controls: Shift / right mouse: grapple the platform ahead

classes.name: Bulwark
classes.flavor: You do not dodge the storm. You become the doorway it breaks against.
classes.ability: Root for 1.6 s, shove everything nearby away; only falling shells can still hurt you.
classes.controls: Shift / right mouse: raise the ward (on the ground)

classes.name: Glider
classes.flavor: Falling is only a slower kind of flight.
classes.ability: Jump once more in mid-air, and hold the ability key while falling to glide.
classes.controls: Space in mid-air: extra jump; hold Shift / right mouse: glide

shop.name: Kept Flame
shop.flavor: A light left burning for a fall that has not happened yet.
shop.effect: +1 life; you respawn at the level start

shop.name: New Hand
shop.flavor: The cards were never yours. Ask again.
shop.effect: Reroll the reward cards offered this lobby

shop.name: Worn Treads
shop.flavor: Old soles, already broken in by someone faster.
shop.effect: +8% run speed for the rest of the run

shop.name: Spring Heel
shop.flavor: A small coil of tension under each step.
shop.effect: +6% jump velocity for the rest of the run

shop.name: Short Fuse
shop.flavor: The dash comes back before you miss it.
shop.effect: -10% dash cooldown for the rest of the run

shop.name: Wide Palm
shop.flavor: Your reach grows a finger's width at a time.
shop.effect: +15% gift pickup reach for the rest of the run

shop.name: Thin Veil
shop.flavor: The mist thins where you look hardest.
shop.effect: -12% fog density for the rest of the run

events.name: High Rise
events.banner: The platforms climb higher and the gaps run wider.

events.name: Slick Ice
events.banner: Every floor is ice: you slide and stop slowly.

events.name: Crumbling
events.banner: Platforms crumble underfoot; keep moving forward.

altars.name: Bargain Altar
altars.flavor: It asks for nothing you will miss until later.
altars.effect: Press E: gain a random upgrade and a random curse. One use per altar.
